verdict.rationale: Stable documents its own features that can surface government and legal mail. It offers keyword-based auto-routing of mail by envelope and content, tags, AI summaries, and Slack/email alerts on new mail. Its registered agent service gives "instant digital access to state and legal mail" with automated routing to act on it quickly, including service of process. However, nothing shows built-in detection of IRS, state or legal mail as a category, a priority or urgent flag, or deadline tracking, so flagging depends on how the operator configures generic routing rules. Missing for 10: automatic classification of government/legal mail, explicit priority or urgency flagging, deadline extraction and reminders, independent or hands-on corroboration.
